title: Application holds write permissions to Intune

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'application has', 'applications have')} write access to Intune

messages.businessImpact: An application credential can change device policy without a person signing in, and application secrets are frequently stored less carefully than user passwords.
remediation: Review each application and confirm it is still in use and still needs write access.
Reduce to read-only permissions wherever the application only reports.
messages.cannotSee: Requires the optional Application.Read.All permission; without it this check is skipped.
